chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Asami narrated from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymi from Ali ibn Asbaat from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Jameel ibn Darraj who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When the male slave marries a free woman, his children are free, and when the free man marries a slave woman, his children are free.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of children when one parent is a slave and the other is free?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'freedom of the mother' (hurriyyat al-umm) in mixed-status marriages, ensuring that children inherit the free status of the free parent, thereby preventing the perpetuation of slavery within the family unit. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is foundational for understanding manumission and the social mobility of slaves, reflecting the Prophet's tradition of liberating offspring to expand the community of the free. It underscores the ethical imperative of emancipation, aligning with the broader Quranic encouragement to free slaves as an act of piety.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Asaamy, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Al Hakam Bin Miseen, from Jameel Bin Darraj who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘When the slave marries the free woman, so his children would be free ones, and when the free man marries the slave woman, so his children would be free ones’.
